problem: Owner OTP succeeded, but account and statement reads exceeded the app 20-second timeout. CloudWatch showed staff reads of 21082 and 23443 ms, proxied as 21244 and 25197 ms.
cause: Financial wrapper revalidated Cognito, branch, deletion fences and session both before and after every internal database read.
fix: Request-scoped read authorization at entry and before returning any result; fresh checks and atomic conditions retained for each financial transaction. No authorization cache across HTTP requests. Notification preference POST also verifies before response.

regressions: Forty internal reads use constant four identity checks at the two boundaries rather than checks per read
Revocation during read blocks response verification
Session expiry, ownership and replay checks remain
